about: Generated by generate_vectors.py; do not edit by hand. TEST KEYS ONLY: every key is derived from its seed_text (seed = SHA-256 of the text; Ed25519: the seed is the private key; ECDSA P-256: the scalar is the seed as a big-endian integer mod (n - 1), plus 1). Records R0 to R2 and links L0 to L2 are those of the portable verification cases. Exports are portable verification 0.1.0 exports. Each checkpoint names the test key it was signed with (signed_with) and gives signed_bytes_hex, the bytes a verifier builds from it under the shared rule, and, where the key signed something else, signature_made_over_hex. cp_accented's chain_id is not ASCII: its length prefix counts 19 UTF-8 bytes, not 17 characters. Each token gives imprint_of_hex, the bytes its messageImprint is the SHA-256 of. A document's bytes as received (for attachment_digest and export_digest) are its JSON with no whitespace, in UTF-8.

chain.about: link(i) = SHA-256(link(i-1) || seal(i)), with 32 zero bytes before the first entry. L0 to L3 chain R0, R1, R2, R4; L1x and L2x chain R0, R1x, R2.
